title: Wi-Fi Telemetry Engineer
reason: Stack +50; Title fit +6; Exp fit +6; US +10
description_preview:
Role Summary
We are seeking a Telemetry Engineer to stand up and operate the telemetry collection and correlation capability for the Client’s enterprise Wi-Fi environment. You will build the data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting that give operations, engineering, and CX teams a trusted, real-time view of wireless health and user experience. The role also covers ongoing operations and maintenance (OMA) of the telemetry platform, ensuring it stays accurate, available, and continuously improving.
Key Responsibilities
Telemetry collection
Design and deploy telemetry collection from wireless controllers, access points, cloud management platforms, and supporting services (RADIUS, DHCP, DNS, switching, and WAN)
Configure data sources and integrations using APIs, streaming telemetry, SNMP, syslog, NetFlow/IPFIX, and vendor analytics platforms
Define data models, naming standards, and retention policies for consistent data across sites and regions
Monitor data quality, completeness, and latency, and resolve ingestion gaps or collector failures
Correlation and analytics
Correlate wireless telemetry with network, authentication, application, incident, and survey data to give an end-to-end view of user experience
Build correlation logic to support faster root cause identification across RF, client, infrastructure, and WAN layers
Develop baselines and anomaly detection to flag emerging issues before users are affected
Enrich data with site, device, and organizational context (location, building, device type, user group)
Dashboards and reporting
Build and maintain operational, engineering, and executive dashboards (e.g., availability, client experience, roaming, capacity, authentication)
Produce scheduled service and SLA reports, and ad hoc analysis on request
Tailor views by audience, including NOC, regional leads, CX teams, and Client stakeholders
Document metric definitions so reporting is consistent and auditable
Health scoring support
Define, implement, and refine site and service health scores using agreed metrics and weightings
Support threshold tuning and alerting based on health score trends
Identify at-risk sites and trends to inform operations, problem management, and optimization priorities
Validate scores against real user experience feedback and adjust the model as needed
Operations and maintenance (OMA)
Operate and maintain the telemetry platform, including upgrades, patching, capacity planning, and backups
Manage access control, data security, and compliance requirements for collected data
Respond to platform incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs
Maintain runbooks, architecture diagrams, and onboarding guides for new sites and data sources
Automate onboarding, reporting, and maintenance tasks to reduce manual effort
Required Qualifications
3+ years of experience in network monitoring, observability, data engineering, or network automation
Working knowledge of Wi-Fi technologies (802.11, RF fundamentals) and wireless performance metrics
Hands-on experience with telemetry and monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, Grafana, Elastic, Prometheus, SolarWinds, or similar)
Experience integrating with vendor platforms and APIs (Cisco, Aruba, Juniper Mist, Ruckus, or similar)
Proficiency in scripting (Python or similar) and data querying (SQL, SPL, or equivalent)
Understanding of TCP/IP, VLANs, DHCP/DNS, and 802.1X/RADIUS
Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
CWNA, CCNA/CCNP, or vendor analytics certifications
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and data pipeline tools
Experience building health scoring or service level indicator frameworks
ITIL Foundation certification
Experience with AIOps or machine learning-based anomaly detection
Key performance indicators
Telemetry coverage (percentage of sites and devices reporting) and data completeness
Platform availability and data latency
Dashboard and report accuracy, timeliness, and adoption
Health score reliability and correlation with user-reported experience
Reduction in manual reporting effort through automation
SLA compliance for platform incidents and requests

description_preview:
Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.
Code that saves lives.
As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.
Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.
The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.
Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.
Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).
More than just important work
.
Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.
We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.

BS/BA or greater in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
A history of academic excellence or professional success
Eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (persons with appropriate qualifications and eligible for TN status under NAFTA may apply)
COVID-19 vaccination

The

at

Interest in learning cancer biology, genomics, and precision medicine applications.

JavaScript/TypeScript

Experience with one or more server-side technologies including Go, Java, C#, C++, or Python
Relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL

Full-stack application architecture and development
Systems design and software troubleshooting
Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with Kubernetes and/or AWS cloud environments
Coursework or professional experience in biology, genetics, genomics, or bioinformatics

Design, develop, and analyze mixed-signal circuit blocks and subsystems.

description_preview:
Overview
Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be, and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and sky-is-the-limit thinking in a cloud-enabled world.
Within the Azure Monitor team, we are looking for a
Software Engineer II and Senior Software Engineer
to help build and evolve the Azure Monitor backend systems. This role is ideal for someone who can own complex, globally distributed systems end to end, drive architecture across teams, improve reliability and security at scale, and shape how AI-assisted and AI-agentic capabilities are safely applied to infrastructure operations. You will work on services that have to continue to scale for usage with the entire fleet, enabling telemetry scenarios for every workload.
Microsoft's Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging and real-time analytics, and business intelligence. The products in our portfolio include Microsoft Fabric, Azure SQL DB, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, and Power BI. Our mission is to build the data platform for the age of AI, powering a new class of data-first applications, and driving a data culture.
Within Microsoft Fabric, the Azure Monitor team builds services that enable customers to monitor, detect, troubleshoot, and mitigate issues with their services through an increasingly agentic experience. Azure Monitor includes Log Analytics, Application Insights, Container Insights, Hosted Prometheus, Azure Managed Grafana, and more. Additionally, Azure Monitor is the platform upon which Microsoft Sentinel is built. We have a multi-billion dollar business that is growing rapidly, and we run some of the world’s highest scale observability services both for Microsoft internally and for our external customers, processing over 1.5 Exabytes of logs daily and tracking over 100 billion active metrics.
We embrace a fast-paced, startup-like culture focused on shipping early and often, with an emphasis on attention to detail, introspection, and accountability. Collaboration is at the heart of our team. We build on each other's ideas and empower engineers to innovate from the ground up, delivering world-class value at speed. If you're passionate about building the systems that power Azure's observability and health at hyperscale and thrive in an environment that values creativity, collaboration, and technical excellence, we'd love to hear from you.
Responsibilities
Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate highly available distributed services and automation used to configure and migrate large-scale telemetry workloads that will be leveraged across the fleet.
Build and enhance APIs, tools, and subsystems for telemetry collection, routing, storage, and efficient data access.
Integrate advanced capabilities (e.g., machine learning–based anomaly detection and data validation) to enhance platform intelligence and insights.
Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and diagnostics and ensure production services run reliably, including participation in on-call rotations and incident response.
Collaborate with partner teams to deliver end-to-end observability solutions and contribute to design reviews and best practices that uphold high engineering standards.
Help evolve how the team builds with AI, championing agentic development practices and sharing repeatable patterns that improve engineering velocity and quality, as well as training and evolving AI to assist with non-coding scenarios such as site reliability engineering, support and administration.
Qualifications
Required/Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C#, Java, .NET, or Python OR equivalent experience.
Job Requirements: Other & Additional
Requirements
The ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screenings:
Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
Preferred/Additional Qualifications
Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C#, Java, .NET, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C#, Java, .NET, or Python OR equivalent experience.
Experience with cloud-native infrastructure, distributed systems, or large-scale production services.
Experience improving reliability, security, observability, networking, or operational excellence for live services.
Experience partnering across teams to deliver infrastructure capabilities with clear ownership and supportability.

As a Digital Engineering Consultant (PLM Implementation) Senior Associate, you will specialize in optimizing operational efficiency and effectiveness within our Operations Consulting practice. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, grow your personal brand, and deepen your technical skills. Implementing lean manufacturing principles to optimize supply chain integration
Leveraging digital technologies to streamline processes and drive business performance
Conducting feasibility studies and market trend analysis to inform product strategy
Managing project resources and overseeing product lifecycle management initiatives
Collaborating with clients to provide guidance on operations management and strategy
Utilizing analytical thinking to interpret data and inform insights and recommendations
Upholding professional and technical standards in compliance with firm guidelines
Embracing change and fostering innovation in product development and manufacturing processes

WHY DEPT®?
We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.
We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.
At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.
What We Believe In
We build software for the world's most ambitious brands, and we're opinionated about how it gets made:
Code quality is a top priority. Style guides, code reviews, and best practices are how we move fast without breaking things. You'll also get your hands on a wide range of cutting-edge technology.
Great UI/UX is critical. Aesthetics, usability, and speed are all part of the product. A technically correct experience that feels bad isn't finished.
Collaboration wins projects. Great communication is the single strongest predictor of whether a project goes well.
We're pragmatic. We know what to build and what to leave alone, and we make real-world tradeoffs between cost, speed, and craft. Shipping something useful beats architecting something perfect.
We're intellectually curious. We're constantly learning through craft show & tells, lunch & learns, workshares, and active Slack channels full of talented engineers across the globe.
The role
As a Senior Engineer, you own significant portions of a project and drive them to completion. You take a semi-defined problem, ask the questions that sharpen it, turn it into a plan, and ship it. You're past the stage of needing fully specified tasks handed to you, and you're building the judgment to know which task matters most.
You're comfortable working alongside product managers, engineers, marketing, sales, and finance, and you can explain your work to any of them without retreating into jargon. Most of what we build depends on getting those people to a shared understanding of what's being made and why.
This role is primarily backend focused, occasionally diving into cloud infrastructure. However, you should also be comfortable enough in a modern frontend codebase to apply best practices and create something visually appealing and smooth to use.
What You'll Do
Build and deploy scalable backend services and APIs for global brands, taking high ownership of your workstreams and their dependencies.
Take specs that are incomplete or ambiguous, resolve the open questions, and turn them into clear requirements, tasks, and stories with time-to-complete estimates people can plan around.
Participate in technical design of systems, schemas, and pipelines, and offer sound guidance on architecture and infrastructure decisions.
Integrate third-party APIs and systems, and design the contracts that frontend teams and other services build against.
Perform code reviews that raise the bar, both submitting your own work and giving constructive feedback that makes your teammates better.
Surface technical blockers, risks, and client-facing issues early enough for the team to course-correct.
Advocate for best practices in testing, security, performance, and CI/CD, and encourage others to do the same.
Work directly with working-level client stakeholders over email, on calls, and in person, and start building demo and presentation content of your own.
Apply AI and agentic capabilities to real client work, and contribute back to how the craft adopts them through reusable templates, prototyping sessions, and practical guidance for other teams.
Share what you learn, internally through Slack, brown bags, and DEPT U, and externally through articles or talks as project work allows.
What You Bring
Proven experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems used by real people.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience designing and integrating APIs and third-party systems.
Solid working knowledge of database platforms, both SQL and NoSQL.
Enough familiarity with modern frontend development (preferably Angular and Typescript) to read the code, review a PR, and debug across the stack.
Experience with at least one major cloud provider. Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome.
Daily, real-world use of GenAI productivity tools (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in your development workflow.
A working understanding of core LLM concepts and where they're a good fit for a problem.
Fluency with version control (git), Agile processes, and CI/CD tooling.
The ability to research independently and know when to ask for help, without spinning wheels on already-solved problems.
A track record of "getting sh*t done" in a fast-paced environment.
Bonus points
Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their careers.
Exposure to agent development frameworks.
Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference speaking.

Process Engineer I
Position Overview
Entry-level Process Engineer supporting day-to-day operations and continuous improvement of food manufacturing processes. The role focuses on optimizing production performance, ensuring food safety and regulatory compliance, and assisting with project implementation across meat processing, rendering, and further-processing lines.
Key Responsibilities
Support process optimization and capacity improvement initiatives across meat processing, rendering, and further-processing lines to increase yield, throughput, and efficiency.
Collect, analyze, and report production data (cycle times, yields, downtime, scrap) to identify trends and root causes; recommend corrective actions.
Troubleshoot equipment and process issues on the plant floor; work with maintenance and operations to implement short-term fixes and long-term solutions.
Develop, update, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and process documentation to reflect current best practices.
Assist in the installation, start-up, and validation of new equipment and process changes; coordinate vendor activities and testing as needed.
Support food safety and regulatory programs (HACCP, GMPs, SSOP, FSMA) by providing technical input, participating in audits, and ensuring process controls are maintained.
Lead or participate in small capital and continuous improvement projects using Lean/Six Sigma principles to reduce waste and improve quality.
Train and mentor operators and technicians on process controls, data collection practices, and safe operating procedures.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Quality, Maintenance, Operations, and Supply Chain to align process improvements with business objectives.
Use manufacturing systems and tools (e.g., MES, SCADA, PLC interfaces, Redzone) to monitor performance, manage targets, and drive accountability.
Qualifications
Bachelors degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial, Agricultural Engineering, Food Science, or related discipline.
0-3 years of hands-on experience in food manufacturing, meat processing, rendering, or further processing preferred; internship or co-op experience is a plus.
Working knowledge of food safety systems and regulations (HACCP, GMPs, SSOP, FSMA) and experience supporting audit readiness.
Familiarity with process control systems, PLC/SCADA basics, and data analysis tools (Excel, Minitab, or similar).
Experience with or willingness to learn production performance platforms such as Redzone, and familiarity with MES/ERP systems (e.g., SAP) is desirable.
Demonstrated problem-solving skills, ability to perform root cause analysis, and apply continuous improvement methods (Lean/Six Sigma foundation preferred).
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively on the plant floor and across departments.
Ability to work in a manufacturing environment (including PPE usage), lift moderate weight, and occasionally work flexible shifts as required.
